shared_elements: human head/face rendered frontally or in profile
incised linear detailing (rows of teeth / brickwork courses rendered as grids of short lines)
justification: The only real overlap is that both depict human heads/faces and use fine incised linear patterning (the grid of teeth in A, the grids of masonry and crenellation in B). Otherwise A is a single sculpted head in the round with a heavy lobed headdress and no scene, while B is a narrative low relief of a multi-figure siege with archers, a wheeled ram and fortified towers — different subject, arrangement and relational structure entirely.
